# NDDev icons

The icons of the design, exported from the Figma frames and reduced to geometry: `svg/<name>.svg` (paths in `currentColor`, the root `fill="none"`), `icons.json` with each one's viewBox, origin set, licence (MIT, Apache-2.0 or ISC) and frame. Icons are decorative: the control around one carries its meaning, so they are hidden from assistive technology.

Native packages draw the same geometry without image files: SwiftUI `NDVectorImage`, Compose `NDIcon.imageVector`, Flutter `NDVectorIcon`, Rust `Icon::vector()`; the web inlines `packages/web/icons.json`.

Consume a release: copy this directory from the tag `vX.Y.Z` into the product and record the tag and the directory digest (docs/adr/0001-architecture.md §13). Never edit the copy; update it from a newer tag.
